_comment: MetrIQ verified standards registry (Phase 14). Product -> Indian Standard lookup uses ONLY these hand-verified records. Never add a row that has not been checked against an official BIS source. This is deliberately separate from data/knowledge/ (the BIS Q&A knowledge base): that set has no food-product standards. FSSAI regulations are NOT Indian Standards and must not be added here.
